answer: Miscellaneous >> Others Question ID: 9859 Country: United Kingdom Title: Asalamu alaikum, I am eager to know what, seeing 2 of your family members go to hajj then come back can mean in a dream. Also, what does being scared that you will miss a prayer, or missing a prayer in dreams mean? Jazak Allah. Question: Asalamu alaikum, I am eager to know what, seeing 2 of your family members go to hajj then come back can mean in a dream. Also, what does being scared that you will miss a prayer, or missing a prayer in dreams mean? Jazak Allah. Answer ID: 9859 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 2606/2102=H/1429) (1) If tilawah is done punctually in the house, there shall be great benefit to the family members in-shaAllah. This is the interpretation of the dream. (2) There is negligence towards zikr , salah , tilawah and fulfilling rights. May Allah protect us! Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
